استشكلت (form X)
# اِسْتَشْكَلْتُ (istaškaltu) /is.taʃ.kal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اِسْتَشْكَلْتَ (istaškalta) /is.taʃ.kal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اِسْتَشْكَلْتِ (istaškalti) /is.taʃ.kal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اِسْتَشْكَلَتْ (istaškalat) /is.t
